{/* Generated by scripts/sync-templates.mjs from the keyly repo templates — do not edit */}

Keyly reads shortcuts from each app's menus, but many apps also have shortcuts that never appear in a menu. Community templates fill that gap: 31 ready-made `.keyly` files with 2,850 shortcuts in total. Pick an app to see every shortcut in its template and the one-line install command, or read [how templates work](/configuration/templates/).
